name: agentic-spec-team
description: Evidence-first ZOB workflow for producing detailed implementation specs from missions plus docs/data/mockups through a run-scoped agent team.
noShipBlockers: secret-like source path or sensitive raw data persisted without approval
requirement without source, answer, assumption, or decision support
acceptance criterion not mapped to requirement
task not mapped to acceptance criterion

stages.name: source-intake
stages.expectedOutcome: Inventory approved sources, sensitivity, freshness, owners, contradictions, and open questions with citations.
mustDo: Use only explicit sources from run-manifest.json.
stages.context: Agentic Spec Team run {run.id}; source intake stage.

stages.name: specialized-analysis
stages.expectedOutcome: Produce data/domain/UX analysis artifacts and candidate traceability rows.
mustDo: Cite source refs for each finding.
Propose questions to spec-chief when blocked.
mustNotDo: No direct human questions except through spec-chief.
No edits outside the run directory.
stages.context: Agentic Spec Team run {run.id}; data/domain/UX analysis.

stages.name: spec-synthesis
stages.expectedOutcome: Synthesize mission spec, requirements, acceptance criteria, BDD, and workgraph from cited analysis artifacts.
mustDo: List non-functional requirements and edge cases.
Map implementation tasks to acceptance criteria.
stages.context: Agentic Spec Team run {run.id}; spec synthesis.

stages.name: oracle-validation
stages.expectedOutcome: Validate source-to-requirement-to-task traceability, question closure, sensitive data posture, and final no-ship status.
mustDo: Fail if blocking questions remain open.
Fail if final-report PASS/no_ship=false is unsupported.
stages.context: Agentic Spec Team run {run.id}; final oracle gate.
